paragraphs.source_en: “I will feed them to the prisoners of this fortress,” he said. “These men and women you think should rule instead of Gold. Once you see the animal in man, you will know that I am right and you are wrong. Gold must rule.”

units.source_en: “I will feed them to the prisoners of this fortress,” he said.
“These men and women you think should rule instead of Gold.
Once you see the animal in man, you will know that I am right and you are wrong.

ja.t: っているとわかるだろう。

paragraphs.source_en: Let them go, the darkness says. The sacrifice is practical. It is wise.

units.source_en: Let them go, the darkness says.

paragraphs.source_en: “No…I won’t…”
Your mother would want you to live.

units.source_en: Your mother would want you to live.

paragraphs.source_en: Not at that price.
What man could grasp a mother’s love? Live. For her. For Eo.

units.source_en: What man could grasp a mother’s love?

paragraphs.source_en: Could she want that? Is the darkness right? After all, I’m important. Eo said so. Ares said so; he chose me. Me of all the Reds. I can break the chains. I can live for more. It’s not selfish for me to escape this prison. In the grand scheme of things, it is selfless.

units.source_en: Ares said so; he chose me.
It’s not selfish for me to escape this prison.
In the grand scheme of things, it is selfless.

paragraphs.source_en: Yes. Selfless, really…

Mother would beg me to make this sacrifice. Kieran would understand. So would my sister. I can save our people. Eo’s dream must be made real, no matter the cost. It’s my responsibility to persevere. It is my right.

units.source_en: Mother would beg me to make this sacrifice.
Eo’s dream must be made real, no matter the cost.

ja.t: にしなければならない。

paragraphs.source_en: Say the words.
I slam my head into the stone and scream at the darkness to go away. It cannot trick me. It cannot break me.

units.source_en: I slam my head into the stone and scream at the darkness to go away.

paragraphs.source_en: Didn’t you know? All men break.
Its high cackle mocks me, stretching forever.

units.source_en: Its high cackle mocks me, stretching forever.

paragraphs.source_en: And I know it is right. All men break. I did already under his torture. I told him that I was from Lykos. Where he could find my family. But there is a way out, to honor what I am. What Eo loved. To silence the voices.

units.source_en: And I know it is right.
I did already under his torture.
I told him that I was from Lykos.
Where he could find my family.
But there is a way out, to honor what I am.

paragraphs.source_en: “Roque, you were right,” I whisper. “You were right.” I just want to be home. To be gone from here. But I can’t have that. All that’s left, the only honorable path for me, is death. Before I betray even more of who I am.

units.source_en: I just want to be home.

ja.t: だが、それはかなわない。

units.source_en: All that’s left, the only honorable path for me, is death.
Before I betray even more of who I am.

paragraphs.source_en: Death is the way out.
Don’t be a fool. Stop. Stop.

I lurch my head forward into the wall harder than before. Not to punish, but to kill. To end myself. If there is no pleasant end to this world, then nothingness will suffice. But if there is a Vale beyond this plane, I will find it. I’m coming, Eo. At last, I am on my way. “I love you.”

units.source_en: I lurch my head forward into the wall harder than before.
Not to punish, but to kill.
If there is no pleasant end to this world, then nothingness will suffice.
But if there is a Vale beyond this plane, I will find it.
At last, I am on my way.

paragraphs.source_en: No. No. No. No. No.
I crash my skull again into stone. Heat pours down my face. Sparks of pain dance in the black. The darkness wails at me, but I do not stop.

units.source_en: I crash my skull again into stone.
Sparks of pain dance in the black.
The darkness wails at me, but I do not stop.

paragraphs.source_en: If this is the end, I will rage toward it.

units.source_en: If this is the end, I will rage toward it.

paragraphs.source_en: But as I pull back my head to deliver one last great blow, existence groans. Rumbling like an earthquake. Not the darkness. Something beyond. Something in the stone itself, growing louder and deeper above me, till the darkness cracks and a blazing sword of light slashes down.
